data.body: Landed as 0886e96f03a (Gerrit 3174, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). 63 operator-shell aws commands across the 13 listed runbooks now pass --profile frontier. A re-run of the inventory grep over infra/runbooks/ leaves 4 lines without the flag, all listed exclusions: the bedrock-runtime call inside the send-command payload (bedrock-access.md:72) and descriptive prose (gerrit-data-volume-reclaim.md:44, gerrit-host-wedged-ssm-lost.md:4-5). AGENTS.md states the --profile frontier rule, the AWS_PROFILE=frontier requirement for Terraform under infra/, and the on-instance exception. docs/local-dev-env.md's TL;DR exports AWS_PROFILE=frontier. tests/unit/test_secret_rotation_runbook.py now pins the profiled mirror-sync command. make lint passed; the 468 tests that read runbooks, AGENTS.md or local-dev-env passed.
